attributes.title: HOPA Annual Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 HOPA Annual Conference of the Hematology/Oncology Pharmacy Association takes place March 31 to April 2, 2027, in St. Louis, Missouri. It brings together hematology/oncology pharmacists, residents and other members of the cancer care team for three days of education, research posters and networking.

The meeting is at the America's Center Convention Complex, and HOPA says it will offer 30.5 CE credits, including 8.0 BCOP credits. The event website with the schedule is live; early-bird registration and housing open in early December 2026. Early-bird fees are $599 for full and associate members and $850 for non-members, rising to $799 and $1,075 after January 22, 2027; residents, fellows and technicians pay less, and student members attend free. Trainee research abstracts are due January 3, 2027.
